Business Development Manager


Job Description


We are looking for a highly motivated Business Development Manager to support our expansion efforts in the European/Asian market. The ideal candidate will focus on executing BD strategies, managing partnerships, and driving user growth through collaborations with agents and KOLs.


Key Responsibilities


  • Execute partnership strategies by identifying and onboarding agents and KOLs to drive trading volume and brand awareness.
  • Manage relationships with existing partners while identifying new opportunities for collaboration within the European/Asian market.
  • Assist in building an agent system tailored to local market needs, ensuring alignment with company objectives.
  • Monitor competitor activities and provide actionable insights to refine BD strategies.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (marketing, operations, product) to ensure seamless execution of growth initiatives.
  • Represent the exchange at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to enhance brand visibility.


Qualifications


  • Minimum 1-2 years of experience in business development within cryptocurrency exchanges or fintech industries.
  • Familiarity with European/Asian market dynamics, including user behavior and promotional models.
  • Fluency in both English and Mandarin are essential.
  • Proven ability to negotiate partnerships and manage relationships effectively.
  • Data-driven mindset with experience using analytics tools to track performance metrics.
